jobs.title: Unterassistenten Innere Medizin

titleByLocale.fr: Unterassin Innere Medizin

jobs.description:
Freie Unterassistentenstellen im Bereich Innere Medizin ab Dezember 2026 verfügbar. Das Kantonsspital Uri engagiert sich in hohem Masse für einen qualifizierten Nachwuchs im Gesundheitswesen und in den nicht medizinischen Berufen. Mit unseren rund 80 Ausbildungsstellen zählen wir zu den grössten Ausbildungsbetrieben in der Region. Eingebettet in der schönen Bergwelt am südlichen Ende des Vierwaldstättersees bietet die Region zahlreiche sportliche (30 Minuten zu diversen Skisportdestinationen) und kulturelle Freizeitmöglichkeiten sowie eine äusserst gute Anbindung an die Stadtregionen Zürich und Luzern. 
• Wir bieten ein- bis viermonatige Ausbildungsplätze in drei verschiedenen Abteilungen an. Die Unterassistenten erhalten eine vielseitige Ausbildung und eine kompetente Betreuung durch die verantwortlichen Ärzte. Auf eine gute Lehr- und Lernkultur sowie ein angenehmes Arbeitsklima und ein vertrauensvoller Umgang legen wir Wert. Die Unterassistenten sind für die Dauer der Ausbildung in ihren ausbildungsbezogenen Rechten und Pflichten gegenüber den vollimmatrikulierten Studierenden der Medizinischen Fakultät Zürich gleichgestellt. Die abgeleistete praktische Ausbildung ist inhaltlich mit derjenigen identisch, die vollimmatrikulierten Medizinstudierenden der Universität Zürich vermittelt wird. Du schätzt die Arbeit im regionalen Spital und wünschst eine ausgezeichnete Ausbildung? Ausserdem verfügst du über gute Deutschkenntnisse (Niveau B2 oder C1)? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit einem Bewerbungsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Kopie der Immatrikulationsbescheinigung sowie aktuellem Notenspiegel. Bei Fragen stehen wir dir unter +41 41 875 51 58 gerne zur Verfügung.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizioni subassista gratuite nel campo della medicina interna disponibili a partire dal settembre 2026. L'Ospedale cantonale Uri è altamente impegnato in un junior qualificato nelle professioni sanitarie e non mediche. Con circa 80 apprendisti, siamo una delle più grandi società di apprendistato della regione. Immersa nelle splendide montagne dell'estremità meridionale del Lago di Vierwaldstätter, la regione offre numerosi sport (30 minuti a varie destinazioni sciistiche) e opportunità di svago culturale, nonché ottimi collegamenti con le regioni della città di Zurigo e Lucerna.
• Offriamo posti di formazione da uno a quattro mesi in tre diversi reparti. I sub-assisti ricevono una vasta gamma di formazione e supporto competente dai medici responsabili. Noi attribuiamo grande importanza ad una buona cultura dell'insegnamento e dell'apprendimento, nonché ad una piacevole atmosfera lavorativa e ad un approccio fiducioso. Per tutta la durata della formazione, i sub-assisti sono trattati come uguali nei loro diritti e doveri di formazione verso gli studenti completamente iscritti della Facoltà Medica di Zurigo. La formazione pratica fornita è identica a quella fornita a studenti medici completamente iscritti presso l'Università di Zurigo. Apprezzi il lavoro nell'ospedale regionale e vuole un'istruzione eccellente? Inoltre, hai una buona conoscenza del tedesco (livello B2 o C1)? Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione con una lettera di domanda, CV, copia del certificato di iscrizione e dello specchio di grado corrente. Se avete domande, siamo a vostra disposizione su +41 41 875 51 58.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Free sub-assistant positions in the field of internal medicine available from September 2026. The Cantonal Hospital Uri is highly committed to a qualified junior in the health care and non-medical professions. With around 80 apprenticeships, we are one of the largest apprenticeship companies in the region. Nestled in the beautiful mountains at the southern end of Lake Vierwaldstätter, the region offers numerous sporting (30 minutes to various skiing destinations) and cultural leisure opportunities as well as extremely good connections to the city regions of Zurich and Lucerne.
• We offer one- to four-month training places in three different departments. The sub-assistants receive a wide range of training and competent support from the responsible doctors. We attach great importance to a good teaching and learning culture as well as a pleasant working atmosphere and a trusting approach. For the duration of the training, the sub-assistants are treated as equal in their training-related rights and duties towards the fully enrolled students of the Medical Faculty of Zurich. The practical training provided is identical in content to that provided to fully enrolled medical students at the University of Zurich. You appreciate the work in the regional hospital and want an excellent education? In addition, do you have good knowledge of German (level B2 or C1)? We look forward to your application with an application letter, CV, copy of the enrollment certificate and current grade mirror. If you have any questions, we are at your disposal on +41 41 875 51 58.

Postes de sous-assistants gratuits dans le domaine de la médecine interne disponibles à partir de septembre 2026. L'Hôpital cantonal Uri est très engagé dans un junior qualifié dans les domaines de la santé et des professions non médicales. Avec environ 80 apprentis, nous sommes l'une des plus grandes entreprises d'apprentissage de la région. Nichée dans les belles montagnes de l'extrémité sud du lac Vierwaldstätter, la région offre de nombreuses activités sportives (30 minutes pour diverses destinations de ski) et de loisirs culturels ainsi que des connexions extrêmement bonnes avec les régions de Zurich et de Lucerne.
• Nous offrons des places de formation de un à quatre mois dans trois départements différents. Les sous-assistants reçoivent un large éventail de formation et un soutien compétent des médecins responsables. Nous attachons une grande importance à une bonne culture d'enseignement et d'apprentissage ainsi qu'à une atmosphère de travail agréable et à une approche confiante. Pendant la durée de la formation, les sous-assistants sont traités comme étant égaux dans leurs droits et devoirs en matière de formation à l'égard des étudiants inscrits à la Faculté de médecine de Zurich. La formation pratique dispensée est identique à celle dispensée aux étudiants en médecine inscrits à l'Université de Zurich. Vous appréciez le travail dans l'hôpital régional et voulez une excellente éducation? En outre, avez-vous une bonne connaissance de l'allemand (niveau B2 ou C1)? Nous attendons avec impatience votre candidature avec une lettre de candidature, un CV, une copie du certificat d'inscription et un miroir de qualité actuel. Si vous avez des questions, nous sommes à votre disposition au +41 41 875 51 58.

Short decision-making paths, a familial DU culture and the opportunity to actively shape the future of our clinic distinguish us. • Certificate of competence Sonography (SGUM) with in-depth practical experience
• Several years of clinical experience and leadership experience in a cadre function are desired
• High social skills, communication skills and an appreciative, team-oriented personality
• Enjoyment of interprofessional cooperation as well as the education and training of young medical professionals
• Commitment to quality, innovation and the continuous development of your health care

• A versatile clinical spectrum in a modern regional hospital with short decision paths

• Progressive employment conditions and attractive social benefits

• Du arbeitest bei der Umsetzung technischer Projekte mit.

• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachfrau/Fachmann Betriebsunterhalt EFZ oder über eine gleichwertige handwerkliche Ausbildung EFZ.
• Du bringst Erfahrung im Betrieb und Unterhalt baulicher Infrastruktur mit.
• Du hast handwerkliches Geschick sowie ein gutes Verständnis für technische und interdisziplinäre Zusammenhänge.
• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office und hast Freude an der Arbeit mit spezifischen Software-Applikationen.
• Du bist eine teamfähige, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit hoher Sozialkompetenz und ausgeprägtem Dienstleistungsverständnis.
• Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und strukturiert und behältst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen den Überblick.
• Du bist flexibel, belastbar und bereit, teilweise unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten sowie Piketteinsätze zu leisten. Unser Angebot
• Ein vielseitiges und sinnstiftendes Arbeitsumfeld in einem modernen Spitalbetrieb.

• Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung eines zeitgemässen Facility Managements mitzuwirken.

• Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und gezielte Förderung deiner beruflichen Entwicklung. • Un ambiente di lavoro versatile e significativo in una moderna operazione ospedaliera.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Our hospital is a central component of healthcare in the region. With a broad range of services, we ensure an outpatient and inpatient extended basic care and offer our patients high-quality medical and nursing care. As one of the largest employers in the region, we attach great importance to innovation, quality and a modern working environment. Facility Management plays a key role in ensuring smooth operation. With modern medical and building technology solutions as well as the completion of our new building and conversions in 2022 and 2024, we offer you an innovative and future-oriented working environment. Here you can actively participate in the design of a contemporary facility management. We are looking for a responsible, dutiful and independent personality immediately or by agreement. YOUR TASKS
• You provide craftsmanship and technical support in the operational maintenance of the building infrastructure and building technology, especially in the area of HVAC.
• You will work on faults, carry out repairs and maintenance work and contribute to the ongoing optimisation of our facilities.
• You organize and coordinate maintenance and maintenance work with external craft companies and service providers.
• You help with the maintenance and care of the outdoor facilities, the garden and the winter service according to the operational plan.
• You support with moves, events and special events.
• You participate in the implementation of safety, hygiene and quality standards.
• You provide piketting service for about 8 to 9 weeks per year as well as occasional assignments outside the regular working hours after assignment planning.
• You support the vocational trainer in the training of learners in company maintenance.
• You are involved in the implementation of technical projects.
• You keep data in the maintenance software CAFM and manage the document storage in your area of responsibility. Your profile
• You have completed training as a specialist company maintenance EFZ or an equivalent craft training EFZ.
• You bring experience in the operation and maintenance of structural infrastructure.
• You have craftsmanship and a good understanding of technical and interdisciplinary contexts.
• You are confident in dealing with MS Office and enjoy working with specific software applications.
• You are a team-capable, communicative personality with a high level of social competence and a strong understanding of services.
• You work independently, reliably and in a structured manner and keep an overview even in demanding situations.
• You are flexible, resilient and willing to perform sometimes irregular working hours as well as piquette assignments. Our offer
• A versatile and meaningful working environment in a modern hospital operation.
• Modern medical and building technology solutions as well as exciting projects in a future-oriented infrastructure.
• The opportunity to actively participate in the further development of a contemporary facility management.
• A motivated team that values cooperation, ownership and mutual support.
• Attractive employment conditions, further education opportunities and targeted promotion of your professional development. Become part of our team and shape the future of medical and building technology in an innovative and modern environment. Our Medical and Building Technology Team Leader, Urban Zurfluh, is at your disposal for questions or further information on +41 875 51 89. We look forward to your application.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Immerso nelle imponenti montagne del Cantone di Uri, all'estremità meridionale del Lago di Quattro Foreste, l'Ospedale cantonale Uri offre una vasta assistenza di base per la popolazione della regione. Come ospedale acuto gestibile, combiniamo brevi percorsi decisionali con una vasta gamma di servizi medici e una stretta cooperazione interdisciplinare e interprofessionale. La clinica fornisce cure anestesiologiche per i dipartimenti operativi e di intervento dell'Ospedale cantonale Uri e svolge un ruolo centrale nella medicina perioperativa. Allo stesso tempo, ha la responsabilità medica per l'emergenza preclinica e la medicina di salvataggio nel cantone di Uri. Le tue domande
• Lei ha la responsabilità generale professionale e personale per l'anestesia clinica e la medicina di salvataggio.
• Condurrai e svilupperai il team medico e lavorerai a stretto contatto con i responsabili della cura dell'anestesia e dei servizi di emergenza.
• Garantisci cure anestesiologiche di alta qualità, sicure e orientate al paziente.
• Rimani clinicamente attivo e partecipi attivamente alla cura perioperativa dei nostri pazienti.
• Siete attivamente coinvolti nella formazione di emergenza preclinica e medicina di soccorso nel Cantone di Uri e lo sviluppo ulteriormente.
• Promuovi l'educazione, la formazione ulteriore e ulteriore dei medici, nonché lo scambio professionale all'interno della clinica.
• Si mantiene una stretta cooperazione interdisciplinare e interprofessionale con i servizi operativi e medici, nonché con i nostri partner esterni.
• Contribuirai a questioni strategiche e cross-cliniche e contribuirai attivamente alla tua esperienza per l'ulteriore sviluppo dell'Ospedale cantonale Uri.

• Una pronunciata cooperazione interdisciplinare e interprofessionale è una questione naturalmente per voi.

• Si assume una posizione chiave responsabile con una grande quantità di spazio professionale e organizzativo per la manovra.
• Avrete l'opportunità di sviluppare e modellare in modo significativo l'anestesia e la medicina di salvataggio nel Canton Uri.

• Puoi presentare immediatamente le tue idee per l'ulteriore sviluppo della clinica e implementarle insieme alla gestione ospedaliera e alle aree specializzate partecipanti.

• Sosteniamo il vostro sviluppo professionale e personale e vi offriamo le condizioni di lavoro aggiornate.
• Il vostro posto di lavoro si trova nel mezzo di una natura attraente e regione di svago con un'alta qualità di vita e buona accessibilità ai centri circostanti. Panagiotis Kanellos, medico principale e rappresentante delle discipline operative, e Fortunat von Planta (fortunat.vonplanta@ksuri.ch), direttore ospedaliero, sarà volentieri disponibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Nestled in the impressive mountains of the Canton of Uri, at the southern end of Lake Four Forests, the Cantonal Hospital Uri offers an extended basic care for the population of the region. As a manageable acute care hospital, we combine short decision-making paths with a broad range of medical services and close interdisciplinary and interprofessional cooperation. For the clinic anesthesia and rescue medicine, we are looking for a professionally and humanly convincing leader as of 01.01.2027 or by agreement, who actively shapes the medical care and successfully develops the clinic together with a committed team. The clinic provides anesthesiological care for the operational and interventional departments of the Cantonal Hospital Uri and plays a central role in perioperative medicine. At the same time, she bears the medical responsibility for preclinical emergency and rescue medicine in the canton of Uri. YOUR TASKS
• You carry the professional and personnel overall responsibility for the clinic anesthesia and rescue medicine.
• You will lead and develop the medical team and work closely with those responsible for anesthesia care and emergency services.
• You ensure high-quality, safe and patient-oriented anesthesiological care.
• You remain clinically active and actively participate in the perioperative care of our patients.
• You are actively involved in shaping preclinical emergency and rescue medicine in the Canton of Uri and developing it further.
• You promote the education, further and further training of doctors as well as the professional exchange within the clinic.
• You maintain a close interdisciplinary and interprofessional cooperation with the operational and medical departments as well as with our external partners.
• You will contribute to strategic and cross-clinical issues and actively contribute your expertise to the further development of the Cantonal Hospital Uri.
• You take responsibility for quality, cost-effectiveness and resource-friendly use within your area of responsibility. Our requirements
• You have an anesthesiology or equivalent recognised qualification recognised in Switzerland. Another specialist title / focus (e.g. intensive care medicine) is an advantage.
• You have proven experience in preclinical emergency and rescue medicine; A corresponding additional qualification is advantageous.
• You have broad clinical experience in anesthesiology and have already successfully assumed leadership responsibility in a senior medical position.
• You master the common procedures of general and regional anesthesia and have a strong interest in perioperative medicine.
• You combine a high level of medical expertise with a good understanding of organizational and business contexts. Further training in business administration is an advantage.
• You lead clearly, appreciatively and bindingly and understand how to promote, involve and win employees for common goals.
• A pronounced interdisciplinary and interprofessional cooperation is a matter of course for you.
• You are a communicative, solution-oriented and decision-making personality with a high level of social competence and a sense of responsibility.
• You enjoy developing the existing, setting new impulses and actively shaping the future of the clinic and beyond. Your perspectives
• You take on a responsible key position with a great deal of professional and organisational room for manoeuvre.
• You will be given the opportunity to significantly develop and shape anesthesia and rescue medicine in the Canton of Uri.
• You combine a chief medical leadership function with a still active and versatile clinical activity.
• You work in a manageable acute care hospital with short decision-making paths, direct exchange and a strong interdisciplinary cooperation.
• You can immediately present your ideas for the further development of the clinic and implement them together with the hospital management and the participating specialist areas.
• You can expect a broad and varied range of medical activities with a high level of personal responsibility.
• We support your professional and personal development and offer you up-to-date employment conditions.
• Your workplace is located in the middle of an attractive nature and leisure region with a high quality of life and good accessibility to the surrounding centers. Ready to help shape anesthesia and rescue medicine in the Canton of Uri? We look forward to your application until 18 October 2026. If you have any questions, Dr. med. Panagiotis Kanellos, chief physician and representative of the operative disciplines, and Fortunat von Planta (fortunat.vonplanta@ksuri.ch), hospital director, will gladly be available.

jobs.description:
Das Kantonsspital Uri bietet dir ein umfassendes Leistungsangebot und stellt die ambulante sowie stationäre erweiterte Grundversorgung für den Kanton Uri sicher. Ausbildung geniesst bei uns einen hohen Stellenwert, und wir legen grossen Wert auf eine individuelle Betreuung und Förderung. Für den Ausbildungsstart im September 2027 suchen wir deine engagierte, verantwortungsbewusste und motivierte Persönlichkeit, die sich für eine spannende und vielseitige Ausbildung begeistert. DEINE AUFGABEN
• In der diagnostischen Radiologie führst du Untersuchungen von Knochen, inneren Organen, Gefässen oder Nervenbahnen durch
• In der Radio-Onkologie setzt du energiereiche Strahlen gezielt gegen krankhaft verändertes Gewebe ein, planst Bestrahlungstherapien und führst diese eigenständig durch. Dabei begleitest und betreust du Tumorpatientinnen und -patienten über längere Zeit.
• In der Nuklearmedizin stellst du mithilfe von radioaktiv markierten Substanzen die Funktion und den Stoffwechsel von Organen sowie Organsystemen dar
• Unabhängig vom jeweiligen Bereich betreust, überwachst und untersuchst du gesunde wie auch kranke Menschen fachgerecht
• Du begegnest Patientinnen und Patienten stets verantwortungsvoll, situationsgerecht und mit hoher fachlicher Kompetenz
• Du arbeitest interdisziplinär mit anderen Fachbereichen zusammen, um die bestmögliche Versorgung sicherzustellen UNSERE ANFORDERUNGEN
• Sek-II-Abschluss (Eidg. Fähigkeitszeugnis, gymnasiale Matura, FMS)
• Technisches Verständnis, manuelles Geschick
• Abstrakt-logisches und vernetztes Denken
• Gute Beobachtungsgabe, Qualitätsbewusstsein
• Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Selbständigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit
• Flexibilität und Improvisationsfähigkeit
• Bestandenes Eignungsverfahren der Höheren Fachschule DEINE PERSPEKTIVEN
• Du erhältst eine zukunftsorientierte Ausbildung zur Radiologiefachperson HF (w/m/d) in einem modernen und innovativen Arbeitsumfeld
• Du arbeitest mit fortschrittlichen Technologien und Diagnostikverfahren auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik

• Werde Teil eines kollegialen und unterstützenden Teams in einer offenen und wertschätzenden Arbeitsatmosphäre

• Sarà sempre incontrare i pazienti responsabilmente, in conformità con la situazione e con alta competenza professionale

• Comprensione tecnica, manualità
• Astratto pensiero logico e in rete
• Buone capacità di osservazione, consapevolezza della qualità
• Competenze di team e comunicazione, indipendenza e affidabilità
• Flessibilità e improvvisazione
• Procedimento di attitudine esistente della scuola superiore

• Lavori con tecnologie avanzate e procedure diagnostiche all'ultimo stato dell'arte
• Si beneficia di una familiarizzazione strutturata e di un supporto stretto da specialisti esperti

• Überwachung des Einsatzes und der Kontrolle von medizintechnischen Geräten

• Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Situationen einzuarbeiten und zeigst Verständnis für Menschen in aussergewöhnlichen Lebenslagen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Our hospital in the Canton of Uri (Switzerland) provides extended basic care for the region and adjacent areas with around 38,500 inhabitants and offers high-quality medical and nursing care. Nestled in the beautiful mountains at the southern end of Lake Vierwaldstätter, the region offers numerous sporting (30 minutes to various skiing destinations) and cultural leisure opportunities as well as extremely good connections to the city regions of Zurich, Lucerne and Ticino. The Internal Medicine Clinic of the Cantonal Hospital Uri operates around 50 acute beds. With empathy and competence, we serve more than 1,700 patients inpatiently and more than 2,400 patients outpatiently every year. More than 90% of hospitalizations take place as an emergency. We have open positions as assistant physician / assistant physician (m/f/d) 100% for the clinic Internal Medicine at the following times:
• October 2026
• December 2027
• January 2028
• March 2028
• May 2028
• October 2028
• November 2028 WHAT YOU EXPECT In a motivated and committed team, you will be involved in the lively operation of a regional and active hospital. The focus of our Internal Medicine Clinic is on gastroenterology, cardiology, oncology, nephrology, neurology, infectiology, emergency medicine and intensive care medicine. Angiology, pneumology and radiology are covered by consultants. We attach great importance to the further education of our assistant doctors, which is also regularly confirmed in the assessment of our further education institution. We also teach the basics of sonography. Our offer As a training institution of category B, the position is suitable for applicants for basic education for 2 years in general internal medicine or as a foreign year. One to two years of clinical experience is beneficial, but not a condition. We look forward to a motivated, responsible and committed personality who is committed to team-oriented, constructive and interdisciplinary cooperation. At the same time, you are interested in working and developing in a collegial and dynamic environment. If interested, there is also the possibility of a rotation into a family doctor's office. In addition:
• Modern infrastructure
• Flat hierarchies and a lived DU culture
• A family and innovative regional hospital with exemplary character Our chief physician internal medicine, Dr. med. Beat Frank, please give you more information. We look forward to your application!

Skifahren in nur 30 Minuten Entfernung) und kulturelle Freizeitmöglichkeiten sowie eine ausgezeichnete Anbindung an die Stadtregionen Zürich und Luzern. • April 2028 WAS DICH ERWARTET In unserer Klinik erwartet Dich ein modernes und vielseitiges Arbeitsumfeld, das durch ein junges, dynamisches Team geprägt ist. Gemeinsam mit einem Chefarzt und vier Fachärztinnen sowie drei Assistenzärztinnen und -ärzten betreuen wir unsere Patientinnen ganzheitlich und mit höchstem Engagement. Unser gynäkologisches und geburtshilfliches Ambulatorium bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, in einem breiten Spektrum der Frauenheilkunde tätig zu sein. Wir begleiten jährlich rund 300 Geburten ab der 36. Schwangerschaftswoche und arbeiten eng mit dem Kinderspital und der Neonatologie des Luzerner Kantonsspitals zusammen, um eine optimale Versorgung von Mutter und Kind sicherzustellen. Darüber hinaus führen wir ein breites Spektrum gynäkologischer Operationen durch. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der umfassenden Behandlung des Mamma-Karzinoms, von der Diagnose über die Operation bis hin zur Nachsorge. Du schätzt die Arbeit in einem regionalen Spital, das durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre und ein breites medizinisches Angebot überzeugt. Eine erstklassige Ausbildung und die Zusammenarbeit in einem interdisziplinären Team sind dir wichtig. Ausserdem bringst du gute Deutschkenntnisse mit (mindestens Niveau C1), um dich problemlos mit Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Patientinnen auszutauschen. Wenn du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten und deine berufliche Entwicklung in einem unterstützenden Team voranzutreiben, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Unser Chefarzt Gynäkologie und Geburtshilfe, Dr. med. Panagiotis Kanellos, MHBA erteilt dir gerne weitere Auskünfte.

Nel campo medico della ginecologia e dell'ostetricia, vi attende un campo di attività versatile e impegnativo. La regione offre anche numerosi sport (ad esempio sci a soli 30 minuti) e opportunità di svago culturale, nonché ottimi collegamenti con le regioni della città di Zurigo e Lucerna. Stiamo cercando personalità motivata come assistente medico / assistente medico (m/f/d) 100% nel campo della ginecologia e ostetricia nei seguenti tempi:
• Aprile 2028 Che cosa aspettate Nella nostra clinica, ci si può aspettare un ambiente di lavoro moderno e versatile caratterizzato da un team giovane e dinamico. Insieme a un medico principale e quattro specialisti e tre medici assistenti, curiamo i nostri pazienti in modo olistico e con il più alto impegno. Il nostro ambulatorio ginecologico e ostetrico vi offre l'opportunità di lavorare in una vasta gamma di ginecologia. Ogni anno accompagniamo circa 300 nascite dalla 36a settimana di gravidanza e lavoriamo a stretto contatto con l’Ospedale dei Bambini e la Neonatologia dell’Ospedale cantonale di Lucerna per garantire una cura ottimale per la madre e il bambino. Inoltre, eseguiamo una vasta gamma di operazioni ginecologiche. Un particolare focus è sul trattamento completo del carcinoma mammario, dalla diagnosi alla chirurgia e al follow-up. Le procedure endoscopiche avanzate e le correzioni di abbassamento genitale (sia vaginale che laparoscopico) vengono eseguite regolarmente. Con più di 9.000 consultazioni ambulatoriale all'anno nel nostro ambulatorio, offriamo l'intero spettro di cure ambulatoriale. Come parte della medicina di fertilità, lavoriamo a stretto contatto con la clinica di fertilità Cada, in modo che tutti i trattamenti di fertilità possono essere offerti nella nostra clinica. Hai il tuo esame di stato in tasca e vuoi iniziare o approfondire la tua formazione specialistica in ginecologia e ostetricia? Forse volete imparare le basi di questa disciplina emozionante durante un anno straniero? Allora hai proprio ragione con noi! Apprezzi lavorare in un ospedale regionale che convince con un'atmosfera familiare e una vasta gamma di servizi medici. Una formazione di prima classe e la cooperazione in un team interdisciplinare sono importanti per voi. Inoltre, avrete una buona conoscenza del tedesco (almeno livello C1) per scambiare facilmente idee con colleghi e pazienti. Se ti senti come lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e guidare il tuo sviluppo professionale in un team di supporto, non vediamo l'ora di incontrarti! Il nostro medico principale Gynecology and Obstetrics, Dr. med. Panagiotis Kanellos, MHBA vi fornirà volentieri ulteriori informazioni.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The Cantonal Hospital Uri, embedded in the impressive mountains at the southern end of Lake Vierwaldstätter, provides basic medical care for around 38,500 inhabitants of the region. In the medical field of gynecology and obstetrics, a versatile and demanding field of activity awaits you. The region also offers you numerous sporting (e.g. skiing only 30 minutes away) and cultural leisure opportunities as well as excellent connections to the city regions of Zurich and Lucerne. We are looking for motivated personality as assistant physician / assistant physician (m/f/d) 100% in the field of gynecology and obstetrics at the following times:
• April 2028 What You Expect In our clinic, you can expect a modern and versatile working environment characterized by a young, dynamic team. Together with a chief physician and four specialists and three assistant physicians, we look after our patients holistically and with the highest commitment. Our gynecological and obstetric ambulatorium offers you the opportunity to work in a wide range of gynecology. Every year we accompany around 300 births from the 36th week of pregnancy and work closely with the Children’s Hospital and the Neonatology of the Lucerne Cantonal Hospital to ensure optimal care for mother and child. In addition, we perform a wide range of gynecological operations. A particular focus is on the comprehensive treatment of mammary carcinoma, from diagnosis to surgery and follow-up. Advanced endoscopic procedures as well as corrections of genital lowering (both vaginal and laparoscopic) are regularly performed. With more than 9,000 outpatient consultations per year in our ambulatory, we offer the entire spectrum of outpatient care. As part of fertility medicine, we work closely with the fertility clinic Cada, so that all fertility treatments can be offered in our clinic. You have your state examination in your pocket and want to start or deepen your specialist training in gynecology and obstetrics? Perhaps you would like to learn the basics of this exciting discipline during a foreign year? Then you are exactly right with us! You appreciate working in a regional hospital that convinces with a family atmosphere and a wide range of medical services. A first-class education and cooperation in an interdisciplinary team are important to you. In addition, you will have a good knowledge of German (at least level C1) in order to easily exchange ideas with colleagues and patients. If you feel like working in a dynamic environment and driving your professional development in a supportive team, we look forward to meeting you! Our chief physician Gynecology and Obstetrics, Dr. med. Panagiotis Kanellos, MHBA will gladly provide you with further information.
